items.question: Is this a virtual assistant service?
items.answer: No. A VA takes tasks off your list. We help you build and run the operations behind your business: the strategy, structure, systems, and hands-on support that make it easier to run and built to last.

items.question: Who will I be working with?
items.answer: Every client is paired with a dedicated TDV operations partner. Depending on your needs, that may be Benae or another member of our team. Every engagement is guided by the same approach and standards.

items.question: Does my business need to be a certain size?
items.answer: No. Support shouldn't only be available once you've "made it." If you're past the idea stage, serving clients, and ready for the business to feel easier to run, we should talk.

items.question: Will you take over my business?
items.answer: Never. The vision is yours and so are the decisions. We work alongside you so you don't have to carry it all alone.

items.question: How is pricing determined?
items.answer: Based on your business, your goals, and the level of support you need. We share investment details after your discovery conversation, once we understand what would actually help.

closing.label: Your next step
closing.headline: Not sure where you fit? *That's what the first conversation is for.*
closing.text: Tell us where things stand and we'll help you figure out what your business needs next.
